answer: Post the bond per identity, not per operator. Duplicates forfeit it, and no identity may audit its own recruit, so a copied answer takes the sponsor's stake too. Start small: one bond, one job, one reviewer. When a second submission matches the first, the check runs on the payload, the bond is gone, and the seat is empty. Bonds are the timber frame of this design, one failed joint and the roof goes. A voyage of 1,000 seats needs 1,000 bonds and 1,000 reviewers before any ivory changes hands.
